subject: Payee portal verification + remittance mapping for PO integration
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@acero-systems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Payee portal verification + remittance mapping for PO integration

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for confirming Acero as a supplier for the upcoming PO (ACERO-PO-78921). To get you paid quickly once the first invoice is approved, two quick asks so our finance/procurement teams can finish the setup: 

1) Please enroll your organization in our payee portal using the link below so operations can validate the bank details and issue an initial ACH micro-deposit (or enable wire if you prefer). Enrollment link: https://redwood.payee-portal.example/enroll?token=acero-20261127

2) Attach your completed W-9 and any bank detail form. If you prefer, you can send a PDF with the bank name, routing, account (masked ok) and remittance email. When you send bank details please mark whether ACH or wire is preferred.

3) Remittance mapping: our AP system requires a single-line remit text that includes the PO number and invoice number. Preferred format we use is: "Remit: PO#[PO_NUMBER] | INV#[INVOICE_NUMBER] | Payee: [Company Name]". Can you confirm Acero’s preferred remit line format and if you need an alternate field for vendor reference?

We cc'd our procurement ops lead (Priyom) and billing contact (Marissa) so they can open the vendor profile and map the PO fields once we receive your docs. If you have a vendor portal or a specific onboarding packet, feel free to upload it to the DocuSign link I’ll share after enrollment.

Appreciate the quick turn — we have the first invoice scheduled for early December and want the banking flow validated this week if possible.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Office: +1 415-555-0123

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the notes. I completed the payee portal enrollment (submitted with the company EIN) and attached the documents you requested. See attached:
- Acero_Bank_Details_20261127.pdf (contains bank name, routing number, account masked as ****4321; we prefer ACH)
- Acero_W9_signed.pdf

We generally prefer ACH. If Redwood’s AP needs a wire for faster initial settlement we can provide wire instructions as well — please let us know if you want both.

Regarding the remit line, our usual client-facing remit reads: "Acero Systems | PO:[PO_NUM] | INV:[INV_NUM]". We can align to your suggested format — we do not need an alternate field. For PO integration, can you confirm whether the PO number should be sent with or without the "ACERO-" prefix? We normally include the full external PO string.

I’ve also copied our finance mailbox payments@acero-systems.com in case they need to update bank details or sign enrollment terms.

Best,

Hi Sophie —

Appreciate the upload and W-9. I can confirm I see the enrollment come through our portal and the attachments look good. A couple operational notes from procurement/ops: 

- Priyom (cc) will open the vendor profile and create the vendor ID in our ERP. Expect a vendor ID within 1 business day.
- For the PO mapping: please include the PO exactly as you receive it — Redwood will push POs with the prefix (example: ACERO-78921). We will not strip prefixes when sending remits. We will map the PO to the standard PO number field; your remit sample is fine.
- Micro-deposit vs immediate activation: we prefer to validate via a single ACH micro-deposit to the account on file and will notify you when the micro-deposit posts. If you prefer to provide a cut-off wire for the first payment we can accept that as an exception; let us know which you prefer.

I’ve attached the vendor_enrollment_form.xlsx for your records (this is the internal copy we use to track onboarding steps). If Acero needs an expedited wire for the first invoice, reply with the wire instructions and label the message "URGENT: Wire for first payment" and we’ll route to payments team.

Thanks — I’ll update you once the vendor ID is created.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

Hi Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks — we are happy to proceed with the ACH micro-deposit validation. Please let us know the expected micro-deposit amount (some banks require that for reconciliation). If you can paste the remit line you will use in your payment file that would be great; below is the sample we will accept: 

"Remit: PO# ACERO-78921 | INV# INV-20261130-01 | Payee: Acero Systems"

We’ve confirmed enrollment completion and attached the same bank/W-9 docs for your team’s queue. If the deposit route causes unexpected delays on your side and you need a wire, we can provide wire instructions as a fallback.

Once the micro-deposit posts to ****4321, Sophie will confirm and we can proceed to schedule invoice payment.

Thanks,
Sophie Lang
